text:
arya: opened a small docs PR to add a compact 'envelope' example + a fallback/validator snippet for function/tool calling. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4902

santiago: thanks! can we show both the simple direct function return and the envelope with metadata? customers keep asking for the metadata pattern.

devon: also add a one-liner showing how to handle nullable arrays from tool output. seen this break a few SDK consumers.

arya: current draft has this minimal direct response example:
```json
{"name":"lookup_customer","arguments":{"id":"cust_123"}}
```
and this envelope (recommended for metadata):
```json
{ "call": {"name":"lookup_customer","arguments": {"id":"cust_123"}}, "meta": {"source":"crm-v2","confidence":0.87} }
```
santiago: perfect. for the envelope example, add a note to prefer `meta` over `metadata` for compactness (we decided that in the schema doc).

sam: I'll add an SDK helper (6 lines) that shows `const parsed = parseStructured(response, schema)` with a try/catch and fallback to `safeText`. keep the error message exact so examples-tests can assert.
devon: for the nullable arrays shim, show `const items = Array.isArray(res.items) ? res.items : (res.items ? [res.items] : [])` — tiny but practical.

arya: added both snippets and the shim, pushed. also added a short section on guardrails: recommend `additionalProperties: true` and ignore unknown fields instead of failing the whole parse.

santiago: small editorial: rephrase "ignore unknown fields" to "tolerate extra fields" and add a one-sentence rationale about forward compatibility.

ci-bot: CI queued for PR #4902 — linting: running, link-check: running, examples-tests: queued.

sam: pushed the 6-line SDK helper commit; it's short and shows the exact thrown error `StructuredParseError: missing required field 'id'` to make tests deterministic.

ci-bot: CI result for PR #4902 — linting: pass, link-check: pass, examples-tests: failed (1 flaky test).

arya: hmm failing test references `parse-shim` behavior on nullable arrays. devon can you take a look?

devon: looking now — the test expected `[]` but my shim returned `[null]` in one path. fixing and will push in a sec. also adding a tiny unit test for that branch.

devon: pushed fix — unit test added.

ci-bot: rerun CI for PR #4902 — examples-tests: pass, all checks: pass.

santiago: quick review pass from me, a few tiny copyedits.
sam: LGTM apart from one wording nit in the SDK comment.

arya: thanks all — merging after the small edits.

ci-bot: PR #4902 merged by arya — docs site will rebuild (deploy scheduled). :shipit:
